subject: ClarifyAI trial: requirements, success criteria, and SDK/API routing handoff
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Lin <jared@clarityai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: ClarifyAI trial: requirements, success criteria, and SDK/API routing handoff

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning, Jared — good alignment on goals. This thread is a concise post-call recap + next steps so we have clear owners for the 4-week trial. If anything below is off, flag it and we’ll adjust.

High-level objective
- Run a 4-week trial of Redwood inference to evaluate latency / cost tradeoffs for your batch scoring + low-latency user queries. Primary use case: nightly scoring of ~300K docs + interactive question-answering against the same data.

Success criteria (proposed) — please confirm:
1) Nightly batch: complete scoring of 300K documents within an 8-hour window with <= 10% CPU/GPU cost variance across runs.
2) Latency SLO: 95th percentile generation latency <= 250ms for interactive queries at baseline load (10rps).
3) Cost target: improve tokens/second cost by >= 20% vs current managed provider for the same prompt set.
4) Quality: generated answers must have >= 85% exact-match on our evaluation prompts (we’ll share a seed prompt set).

Trial scope & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): access & infra setup, NDA/MAA in place, security questionnaire started.
- Week 1: SDK integration (streaming + function/tool calling), sample data ingest, baseline measurements.
- Week 2: Experiment with batching, prefix caching, and quantized model variant for cost runs.
- Week 3: Acceptance tests (latency/cost/quality) and tuning.
- Week 4: Hand-off summary, metrics, and recommendation.

Ownership (Redwood / ClarityAI)
- Infra & SDK handoff: Ben Carter (redwood) — technical lead for routing, streaming, SDK examples.
- Performance & eval: Karthik Iyer (redwood) — success criteria instrumentation and acceptance datasets.
- ClarityAI contact & data: Jared Lin (clarityai) — will provide sample dataset + API keys.

Immediate asks for Kickoff (by end of this week)
- Jared: share sample dataset (anonymized) + preferred SSO/email for API access.
- Jared: complete the security questionnaire link Ben will send (SOC2 scope).
- Ben: attach initial SDK integration guide + streaming sample config — cc’d here.

Attachments referenced: SDK integration guide (pdf), streaming config (yaml).

Next call: propose an initial technical handoff on Friday 11/20 at 10:00 PT — please confirm.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Jared Lin <jared@clarityai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClarifyAI trial: requirements, success criteria, and SDK/API routing handoff

Adding the first-pass technical artifacts — attaching a short SDK quickstart and a streaming-config stub. High level notes:

- SDK routes: we recommend exposing a dedicated /v1/generate endpoint for interactive queries (streaming enabled) and a /v1/batch-score route for the nightly job. Using separate routes will let you apply different batching/cache policies and instance sizes.
- Streaming config (attached streaming-config.yaml): continuous streaming with 32-token prefetch and 100ms max buffer; set max_concurrency=12 for initial tests.
- Tool calling: if you plan to use Redwood’s function calling for retrieval + reranking, we’ll include the tool schema and a short sample for how to register tools in the SDK.

Attachments (in this thread):
- sdk-integration-guide.pdf — contains code snippets for node/python, route examples, and sample env vars.
- streaming-config.yaml — sample values for the trial.
- MAA_ClarifyAI_SOW_v1.docx — draft MAA/statement of work (Olga, please advise on legal/MAA next).

Technical open items (Ben)
1) We need a sample of your typical interactive prompt sizes (avg token in/out) and the size distribution for the nightly documents so we can pre-select model variants and quantization settings.
2) For batch scoring: will the job be submitted as single large payloads, or via a chunked streaming ingestion (better for memory on the worker)?

I’ll follow up with a short checklist and ping when I’ve posted the Drive link to the SDK snippets.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: Jared Lin <jared@clarityai.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ClarifyAI trial: requirements, success criteria, and SDK/API routing handoff

Thanks, Olga and Ben — this looks good and aligns with our internal priorities. Quick answers:

- We’ll provide an anonymized sample of 10K documents today (S3 link below) — typical doc size is 1.2k tokens average, tail up to ~6k.
- Nightly scoring will be submitted as chunked jobs (we prefer resumable uploads).
- Interactive prompts average 220 tokens in/out.

Security & procurement notes:
- I’ve started the security questionnaire (link in the Drive folder). We will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a list of your subprocessor locations for compliance.

S3 sample: s3://clarityai-trial/samples/anon_10k.tar.gz
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3Cclarityai-integration

I can confirm the Friday 11/20 10:00 PT checkpoint for the technical handoff. I’ll invite our data lead (poc@clarityai.com) to that meeting.

—Jared
Jared Lin
Head of ML Engineering | ClarityAI
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jared Lin <jared@clarityai.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClarifyAI trial: requirements, success criteria, and SDK/API routing handoff

Thanks for the dataset link and prompt-size info, Jared — that helps a lot. A couple of clarifications and next steps from the performance side: 

- Acceptance dataset: please confirm which 500 queries we should use for the automated quality/accuracy check. We’ll run exact-match + F1 and produce a report.
- Model variants: based on token sizes, we’ll test two variants (standard FP16 & 4-bit quantized) and track cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Instrumentation: Ben — can you add the route-level tracing headers (X-Request-Trace) to the sdk-integration-guide so we can link to Console traces?

Proposed acceptance checklist for Week 3 (to be completed before final handoff):
- Nightly run within 8-hour window (ops logs + trace)
- 95p latency <= 250ms for 10rps baseline (synthetic load)
- Cost delta >= 20% improvement vs baseline provider (token-level accounting)
- Quality >= 85% exact-match on the 500-query set

I’ll attach a short evaluation-runbook to the Drive folder by EOD. See you on Friday.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Performance Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Jared Lin <jared@clarityai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ClarifyAI trial: requirements, success criteria, and SDK/API routing handoff

Confirmed — I’ve shared the 500-query acceptance seed in the Drive folder and completed the security questionnaire. See you at 10:00 PT.

—Jared
